Carv, founded in 2013 by Jamie Grant and Pruthvikar Reddy, makes CARV — a wearable ski coaching system of boot inserts and trackers that sync with iOS/Android devices. As the business grew to handle hundreds of orders a day, Carv relied on 3PL partners and was forced to manually submit every order, creating a time-consuming bottleneck and limiting its ability to scale.

Orderhive automated order routing to Carv’s 3PLs using smart routing tables and added returns-management visibility, eliminating manual submissions and providing real-time return alerts. The automation freed staff for strategic work, enabled the company to add warehouse capacity and new sales channels, and supported profitable scaling.

Every plant runs differently, and so does every hiring workflow. Carv's AI agents automate the operational work behind high-volume hiring for production, assembly and maintenance roles, from first application to first shift.

Carv’s Host Agent is your always-on front door for candidates, engaging them the moment they enter your funnel. It answers questions, clarifies intent, and guides each candidate to the right next step such as starting pre-screening or exploring a relevant role. By capturing attention early and removing friction, it keeps candidates moving and reduces drop-off before a recruiter gets involved.

Carv’s Scheduling Agent books interviews and next steps by coordinating availability between candidates and hiring teams. This removes back-and-forth, speeds up progression, and keeps the hiring process moving.

Carv’s Rescheduling Agent automatically coordinates interview changes between candidates and hiring teams when plans shift. By handling availability updates and calendar coordination in real time, it eliminates manual back-and-forth, minimizes delays, and keeps the hiring process moving smoothly.

Carv’s Talentpool Rediscovery Agent automatically surfaces the most relevant candidates from your existing talent pools as soon as a vacancy opens. This reduces time-to-fill and turns your database into an always-on source of ready-to-contact talent.
Keep new hires on track to day one. The Onboarding agent keeps every new hire on track between offer and day one, chasing pre-start tasks, answering questions, and flagging anyone at risk.
Turn a rejection into a second chance. The Routing agent catches viable candidates the moment they're rejected for one role and redirects them to another open vacancy, automatically.

Keep your talent pool compliant, automatically. The Compliance agent tracks consent across every candidate record and reaches back out when it needs renewing, so your talent pool stays usable and compliant.
Take admin tasks off your recruiters' plate. The Admin agent joins every interview and intake call, takes notes, and updates your ATS records, so recruiters don't spend time on data entry.
See exactly where hiring is breaking. The Insights agent turns everything happening across your hiring pipeline into one clear picture without anyone pulling a report by hand.
without hiring more recruiters
